civilisation.clue.upstream.record:
Tracks by the river

Wheel ruts end beside the river, but spilled grain continues toward a hillside path. Footprints flank the drag marks, as if several people unloaded the cart and carried its contents together.

There is not enough evidence that the entire party died here. They may have abandoned the vehicles for a difficult trail. The direction of the tracks at the site offers a lead.
civilisation.clue.camp.record:
A familiar bundle mark

A scrap of cloth bears the same mark as the belongings along the river. There are signs of bundles being tied again after a rest, with footprints continuing uphill.

Someone reorganized their belongings here. The party seems to have continued with a plan after leaving the road.
civilisation.point.fire.record:
Rations beside a cold hearth

A few dry rations and food preparation notes remain by the hearth. The cook set aside portable portions, preparing for more than the next meal.

These notes enable dry-ration production at base. Rations restore energy for travel, but do not replace drinking water.
civilisation.point.iron_tools.record:
Repaired axes and picks

The edges have been repeatedly dressed and the handles secured again. A note stresses using the appropriate tool for wood or stone.

The party appears to have prepared to gather materials beyond the cart road. Return with these notes to produce forged axes and picks that shorten the corresponding harvesting work.
civilisation.point.steel_blade.record:
Blade-working notes

Blades lie apart from other supplies, beside notes on shaping and maintenance. Worn-out tools remain; usable ones have been taken.

This looks like a deliberate selection of equipment. Returning these notes enables steel blades with greater damage per successful melee strike.
civilisation.point.bow.record:
Sorted bow supplies

Bow-making and adjustment notes lie beside leftover arrow materials. Usable arrows were selected, leaving parts in need of repair.

Someone prepared weapons before moving on. Return with the notes to make an improved bow that uses the same arrows and deals more damage on impact.
civilisation.point.grain.record:
Divided rations

Bundles near the food preparation site are marked for separate carriers. The remaining grain was distributed among those able to carry it instead of being left together on a cart.

The notes enable prepared grain rations. Each portion restores more energy, leaving more room to explore side trails.
civilisation.point.pottery.record:
A sealed water vessel

Marks around the mouth show a seal, and cord impressions suggest the vessel was secured for travel. A note reminds carriers to check the seal at each rest.

Return with these pottery notes to produce a water pot that restores more water. It does not replace food.
civilisation.point.proof.record:
The transport party's letter

“The carts can go no farther. We have divided the grain we can carry. The injured travel with us; no one remains by the river. Those arriving later should not wait beside the carts. Our old bundle mark shows where we rested. If you return, tell those waiting for news: we left the road and moved on with the remaining grain.”

The letter matches the drag marks and bundle markings. After losing their vehicles, the party redistributed supplies and continued with the injured.

You have secured the record. Return successfully to conclude this investigation. Undiscovered craft notes can be sought on another expedition.
